title: Granola steps
description: A quiet how-it-works on white: a serif statement in the right half, then steps down the right column, each a small serif title, a short paragraph and a large rounded square picture. On desktop a slim step nav stays pinned top-left; as each step crosses the middle of the window its label turns ink and a line fills beneath it. Phones show each step's name as a serif eyebrow instead.
notes: step media are square slots (rounded 16px); empty, a soft lime-wash placeholder
progress uses named view timelines with timeline-scope (Chromium); without support, or with reduced motion, the nav is plain links
idPrefix sets the step anchors the nav jumps to
